QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Collective Strength
QuestInfo.0:
The people of Abrup are gathering for a meeting to come up with a plan.
As you discuss how you came to be here and the monster you encountered in the forest, you stress the importance of working together to remedy the situation. Some agree with you, but most scoff at what they think is a hopeless endeavor. 
You've still got time to convince them though. Keep trying.
